title: New Dance Shawn Reel
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 4 "star promenade left ½ and move right alone to face new couple · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
Row 5 "balance the ring balance in and out" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

Row 6 "mad robins, larks in front this is a( Mad Ricochet ) the larks go into center first and ricochet out with two hands and then the robins do the same thing" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad ricochet needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.

Row 7 "mad robins, larks in front repeat so larks go in and them the robins for a ( Mad Ricochet)" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad ricochet needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 1 "balance robins shift left to neghbor · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: No robins to slide.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
